name: overtimereport-datetimepicker-crash-fix
goal: Fix /overtimereport datetimepicker: the dp.change handlers in resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js read the picker instance via $el.data('datetimepicker'), but the pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker plugin stores the instance under the key 'DateTimePicker' (capital DTP). So $de.data('datetimepicker') is undefined, and the first dp.change (fired on focus via useCurrent) throws TypeError -> aborts the plugin's show() before the widget is created -> no picker ever appears on date_start / date_end. Fix: call the plugin method API ($de.datetimepicker('minDate', v) / $ds.datetimepicker('maxDate', v)), the proven pattern from resources/js/modules/excelreport/form.js.

tasks.title: Fix overtimereport dp.change handlers to use the plugin method API (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Edit ONLY the file resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js. The bug: the two dp.change handlers call $de.data('datetimepicker').minDate(v) / $ds.data('datetimepicker').maxDate(v). The pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker plugin stores the picker instance under the jQuery data key 'DateTimePicker' (capital), so .data('datetimepicker') is undefined and the handler throws, aborting the widget from ever showing. Replace the ENTIRE two handler blocks with the plugin method-call pattern (identical to resources/js/modules/excelreport/form.js, which works): (1) The $ds.datetimepicker(...) chain must become EXACTLY: `$ds.datetimepicker({ ...config.datetimepicker, useCurrent: true }).on('dp.change', function () { var v = $ds.val(); if (v) { $de.datetimepicker('minDate', v); } else { $de.datetimepicker('minDate', false); } });` (2) The $de.datetimepicker(...) chain must become EXACTLY: `$de.datetimepicker({ ...config.datetimepicker, useCurrent: true }).on('dp.change', function () { var v = $de.val(); if (v) { $ds.datetimepicker('maxDate', v); } else { $ds.datetimepicker('maxDate', false); } });` Do NOT touch anything else in the file (the select2 inits and the bootstrapValidator block must remain untouched). Do NOT reformat the rest of the file. Make the minimal edit. Verify: grep -n "datetimepicker('minDate'\|datetimepicker('maxDate'\|data('datetimepicker'" resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js must show the two method calls and ZERO data('datetimepicker') occurrences. Report the grep output.

Verify the overtimereport datetimepicker fix (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Run these checks in order (bash syntax, cd /g/ipma_erp2): (1) grep -n "data('datetimepicker'" resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js - must output NOTHING (exit 1 is fine); (2) grep -c "datetimepicker('minDate'\|datetimepicker('maxDate'" resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js - must output 2; (3) npx mix 2>&1 | tail -3 - must compile successfully (exit 0, webpack compiled); (4) grep -c "data('datetimepicker'" public/js/app.js - must output 0 (the broken pattern must NOT be in the compiled bundle); (5) php artisan test 2>&1 | tail -5 - must pass (48 passed / 161 assertions or better). Report PASS/FAIL for each of the 5 checks with the exact output. If any fails, fix resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js yourself (the two dp.change handlers must use $de.datetimepicker('minDate', v) / $ds.datetimepicker('maxDate', v) plugin method calls) and re-run until green.

## Overtimereport Datetimepicker Crash Fix (2026-08-17)

- Bug: /overtimereport date_start / date_end pickers never appeared.
- Root cause: resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js dp.change handlers read the picker instance via $el.data('datetimepicker'), but pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker stores it under 'DateTimePicker' (capital). The first dp.change (fired on focus via useCurrent) threw TypeError, aborting the plugin's show() before the widget was created.
- Fix: rewrote the handlers to call the plugin method API ($de.datetimepicker('minDate', v) / $ds.datetimepicker('maxDate', v)) - the proven pattern from resources/js/modules/excelreport/form.js. The end picker now blocks dates before the start, and the start picker blocks dates after the end (guard resets to false when empty).
- Verified: headless Edge repro (widget now PRESENT on focus), npx mix compiles, php artisan test passes.
